# School Timetable Builder

> Free, FSL-1.1-MIT-licensed school timetable generator that runs in the browser (nothing uploaded) or as a dependency-free Node command line. Input is plain text, one line per lesson; output is a weekly timetable with no class, teacher or room double-booked, viewable and printable per class, teacher and room, and exportable as CSV.

- Page: https://marisstella.app/school-timetable-builder/
- Guide for schools: https://marisstella.app/school-timetable-builder/free-school-timetable-generator.html
- Source: https://github.com/Duncan-Haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/school-timetable-builder

## Input

- `days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri`, `periods: 6`, `breaks after: 2, 4`
- `rooms: Lab 1 (lab), Gym (gym)`; a lesson option `lab` means any lab, `room Lab 1` pins one
- `7A: Maths / Okafor / 5` (class / subject / teacher / periods per week); options `double`, `2 doubles`, a room type or `room <name>`
- `7A+7B: PE / Garcia / 2 / double / gym` joint classes; `Okafor+Ng` two teachers
- `teacher Okafor: off Mon 1-2, Fri; max 5 per day`, `class 7A: off Fri 6`

## Guarantees and limits

- Hard: no clashes for classes, teachers or rooms; periods off respected; doubles inside one block; room types matched; every lesson placed. Checked by an independent validator; any remaining clash is listed, never hidden.
- Soft (minimised, not proven optimal): class gaps, teacher gaps, same subject twice in a day, teacher daily maximum, late class starts.
- A counting check before solving explains overloaded teachers, classes and rooms.
- Benchmark: 21 of 21 synthetic fully booked schools (4 to 40 classes) solved clash-free in 0.2 to 2.3 s (eval/benchmark-2026-11-16.md). Synthetic, not real schools.
- Not covered: substitution/cover planning, option blocks, split sites, drag-and-drop editing.

## CLI

`node cli.mjs school.txt [--seed N] [--csv out.csv] [--json]`; exit 0 clean, 1 hard problems remain, 2 input error.

The result is a draft timetable to be checked by the person responsible for it, not professional advice.
